codeChanges.what: Add a Topic option to the pregame setup in Four Corners and Quick Check. Choices: All (default, today's behavior), Sight Words (only shows when the grade has sight-word items, Kindergarten today), Decoding (only shows when the grade has decoding items, grades 1-5). snapshots.title: Decoding Strategies handout (LETRS, Moats & Tolman), shared at Sweetwater PL Nov 2026
snapshots.scope: Full text of the one-page handout.
snapshots.content:
Break it down. Sound it out. Read it!
1 Consonant between the vowels: Underline the vowels. When a word has 1 consonant in between the vowels, draw a line before the consonant. If the word doesn't make sense, draw a line after the consonant. Read each syllable. Read the whole word. robot: ro bot
2 Consonants between the vowels: When a word has 2 consonants in between the vowels, draw a line between the consonants. Keep vowel teams, blends, and digraphs together (ea, st, mp, ch, or ph). picnic: pic nic
More Than 2 Consonants between the Vowels: When a word has more than 2 consonants in between the vowels, draw a line between the consonants. Keep vowel teams, blends, and digraphs together. dolphin: dol phin
Smaller Steps = Stronger Readers!

snapshots.title: 6 Syllable Types handout (Thrive Literacy Corner), shared at Sweetwater PL Nov 2026
snapshots.scope: Full text of the one-page handout.
snapshots.content:
closed: ends in a consonant, short vowel sound (cat)
open: ends with a vowel, vowel has long sound (go)
magic e: ends with a silent e, long vowel sound, 1 consonant between the vowel and silent e (cake)
vowel team: 2 vowels making 1 sound (boat)
r controlled: at least 1 vowel followed by r; ar, er, ir, or, ur (star)
consonant -le: ends with a consonant and -le (turtle)

evidence.sourceTitle: Decoding Strategies handout (LETRS, Moats & Tolman), shared at Sweetwater PL Nov 2026
evidence.locator: 2 Consonants between the vowels
evidence.quote: When a word has 2 consonants in between the vowels, draw a line between the consonants.
